John Kanell of Preppy Kitchen joined AM Northwest to make orange pecan cinnamon rolls.

For more information, visit the Preppy Kitchen website.

Orange Pecan Cinnamon Rolls

MAKES 12 ROLLS

FOR THE DOUGH

  • 4 cups (480g) all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
  • ⅔ cup (133g) granulated sugar
  • 2 & 1/4 teaspoons (1/4-ounce envelope/7g) active dry yeast
  • 1 cup (240ml) whole milk
  • 6 tablespoons (85g) unsalted butter
  • 1 tablespoon vanilla extract
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1 large egg, room temperature
  • 1 teaspoon vegetable oil, for the bowl

FOR THE FILLING

  • 5 tablespoons granulated sugar
  • Grated zest of 1/2 orange (about 1 teaspoon)
  • 4 tablespoons firmly packed light brown sugar
  • 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon
  • 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons (85g) unsalted butter, melted, plus more for the pan
  • 1/2 cup (60g) pecans, finely chopped

FOR THE GLAZE

  • 4 ounces (114g) cream cheese, room temperature
  • 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, room temperature
  • 1 pinch kosher salt
  • 1 1/2 cups (180g) powdered sugar
  • Zest of 1/2 orange
  • 1 tablespoon fresh orange juice
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

DIRECTIONS

For the dough

Warm the milk and butter until the butter melts and the mixture is about 110°F. Stir in the yeast and a pinch of the sugar.

Add the flour, sugar, salt, vanilla and egg and knead until smooth. Grease a large bowl with the vegetable oil, add the dough and let rise 1 hour.

For the filling

In a small bowl, mix the granulated sugar, orange zest, brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll out the dough, brush with the melted butter, then sprinkle with the sugar mixture and the pecans.

For the glaze

Beat the cream cheese and butter until smooth. Add the salt, powdered sugar, orange zest, orange juice and vanilla and beat until creamy.
